subject: Cybersecurity
title: Dark Web Forums: The Underground Community
description: A fast breakdown of Dark Web Forums: The Underground Community for builders.

hook.text: Hidden forums on the dark web function like Reddit for criminals – complete with tutorials, reviews, and reputation scores.

buildup.text: Dark web forums are organized by specialty: carding, hacking, malware development, fraud, and data trading.

discovery.text: Reputation systems and escrow services reduce scams between criminals. Trust infrastructure mirrors legitimate e-commerce.

twist.text: Many forum members are undercover law enforcement. The FBI once ran an entire dark web forum for months to identify users.

climax.text: Dark web forums are universities of cybercrime. Newcomers learn techniques and build networks that fuel real-world attacks.

punchline.text: The FBI ran a criminal forum. To catch the criminals using it.

quiz.question: How do dark web forums build trust between criminals?
options: They use reputation systems and escrow services similar to legitimate marketplaces
